blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: This report presents the implementation and validation of two end-to-end multimodal adaptation pipelines for 3D-aware visual question answering on a custom spatial dataset. The first pipeline fine-tunes HiSpatial-3B, which augments RGB observations with metric-scale 3D point maps; the second adapts Qwen3-VL through memory-efficient QLoRA-based supervised fine-tuning. The completed engineering stack covers dataset conversion, image-annotation alignment, monocular geometry preprocessing, instruction construction, mixed-domain training, checkpoint management, batch inference, and automated evaluation. On the target spatial benchmark, HiSpatial adaptation increases overall accuracy from 1.73% before fine-tuning to 79.89% at 3,600 steps. On a separately collected styled split, accuracy improves from 14.9% to 55.1%, indicating transfer beyond the original training set. The Qwen3-VL pipeline is likewise implemented end-to-end for both 8B- and 32B-scale models using mixed-domain QLoRA adaptation. The resulting accuracy improves from 20.74% to 45.27% for Qwen3-VL-8B and from 30.79% to 47.60% for Qwen3-VL-32B. Together, these results establish two complementary and reproducible adaptation pipelines for geometry-aware and general-purpose multimodal spatial reasoning. These results establish a reproducible engineering foundation for subsequent work on metric 3D reasoning, spatial grounding, and domain-adapted multimodal systems, while also identifying training-data composition as a central factor in preserving general multimodal capability during specialization.
blocks.zh: 本报告介绍3D-意识视觉问题回答自定义空间数据集两个端到端多模式适应管道的实施和验证情况。 第一条管线微调HiSpatial-3B,用公尺比例的3D点地图来增强RGB的观测;第二条通过内存高效的QLORA监督微调来调整Qune3-VL. 已完成的工程堆栈包括数据集转换,图像-注释对接,单相位几何预处理,指令构建,混合域培训,检查站管理,分批推论,以及自动化评价. 在目标空间基准上,HiSpatial适应将总体精度从微调前的1.73%提升到3600步的79.89%. 在单独收集的分词中,精度从14.9%提高到55.1%,表明转调超过了原培训集。 Qune3-VL输油管同样采用混合域QLORA的适应性,为8B和32B级两种型号实施端到端. 由此产生的精度从20.74%提高到45.27%,Qune3-VL-8B的精度从30.79%提高到47.60%. 这些结果共同为几何意识和通用多模式空间推理建立了两个互补和可再生的适应管道. 这些结果为今后关于计量三维推理、空间地基和经域调整的多模式系统的工作奠定了可复制的工程基础,同时也将培训数据构成确定为在专业化期间保持一般多模式能力的一个核心因素。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved strong performance in semantic recognition, captioning, and visual question answering, but reliable metric 3D reasoning remains substantially more challenging when the model observes only a 2D image. The target project focuses on spatial tasks that require both semantic understanding and geometric sensitivity, including object counting, building-height estimation, footprint comparison, pairwise distance estimation, spatial ordering, and relative-direction reasoning.
blocks.zh: 视觉语言模型(VLMs)在语义识别,字幕和视觉问答方面都取得了强效的性能,但当模型只观测到一个2D图像时,可靠的度量3D推理仍然具有更大的挑战性. 目标项目侧重于既需要语义理解又需要几何敏感性的空间任务,包括物体计数,建筑高度估计,足迹比较,双向距离估计,空间顺序,以及相对方向推理.

blocks.en: The objective of this work is to build and validate a practical adaptation stack for strong open-source multimodal models on the provided 3D-aware dataset, rather than to train a new foundation model from scratch. Two complementary model families are studied. HiSpatial explicitly injects geometric information through a metric point-map branch and is therefore naturally suited to quantitative and relational spatial reasoning. Qwen3-VL, by contrast, provides a strong general-purpose multimodal baseline with learned spatial and 3D grounding capabilities, enabling us to evaluate how far task specialization can be achieved through instruction tuning alone.
blocks.zh: 这项工作的目标是在提供的3D-意识数据集上为强大的开源多式联运模型建造和验证一个实用的适应堆,而不是从零开始训练一个新的基础模型. 研究两个互补的模范家庭. HiSpatial明确通过一个度量点映射分支注入几何信息,因此自然适合定量和关系空间推理. 与此相反,Qune3-VL提供了一个强大的通用多式联运基线,具有已学习到的空间和三维地面能力,使我们能够评价单靠教学调谐可以实现的任务专业化的程度。

blocks.en: The completed work delivers the following engineering outcomes: • a model-independent data layer that converts the provided scenes into aligned image–question–answer records and supports reproducible train/test splits; • an RGB+3D preprocessing pipeline for HiSpatial based on monocular point-map estimation and WebDataset serialization; • mixed-domain HiSpatial supervised fine-tuning, checkpointed inference, and automated evaluation, with target accuracy improving from 1.73% to 79.89%; • Qwen3-VL QLoRA pipelines for both 8B and 32B variants, including instruction conversion, low-memory training, checkpoint loading, and standardized evaluation; • a unified prediction/evaluation interface for comparing spatial VLMs on the same JSONL benchmark; and • an empirical diagnosis of narrow-domain over-specialization in Qwen3-VL, which motivates mixed-domain sampling and stronger retention controls in subsequent experiments.

blocks.en: II Model Principles and Literature Background
blocks.zh: 二. 示范原则和文学背景

blocks.en: II-A HiSpatial: Hierarchical 3D Spatial Understanding
blocks.zh: II-A 空间:三维空间理解

blocks.en: HiSpatial formulates 3D spatial intelligence as a four-level hierarchy: basic geometric perception, object-level spatial understanding, inter-object relational understanding, and abstract spatial reasoning [ 1 ] . The hierarchy spans low-level depth or point queries, object-centric properties such as physical size and orientation, pairwise relations such as distance and direction, and higher-level tasks including perspective taking and multi-step spatial problem solving.
blocks.zh: HiSpatial将3D空间智能表述为四级层次:基本几何感知,对象级空间理解,对象间关系理解,抽象空间推理[1]. 层次跨越低层深度或点查询,物理大小和方向等对象中心属性,距离和方向等对等关系,更高层次的任务包括取景和多步空间问题解决.

blocks.en: A central architectural choice is to supplement RGB appearance with explicit geometric information. During both training and inference, a monocular geometry estimator produces a point map 𝐏 = G ⁡ ( 𝐈 ) , 𝐏 ∈ ℝ H × W × 3 , \mathbf{P}=G(\mathbf{I}),\qquad\mathbf{P}\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W\times 3}, (1) where 𝐈 \mathbf{I} denotes the RGB image and each pixel is associated with a 3D coordinate. HiSpatial uses MoGe-style monocular geometry estimation, whose original formulation predicts an affine-invariant point map from a single image [ 3 ] . Metric-scale point maps are especially relevant to the target benchmark because several tasks require quantitative reasoning in physical units rather than only qualitative spatial relations.
blocks.zh: 一个中心建筑选择是用明显的几何信息来补充RGB外观. 在培训和推论期间,一个单极几何估计器会生成一个点图P=G ⁡(I),P ∈ R H × W × 3,\ mathbf{ P}=G(\mathb{I}),\quad\ mathbf{ P}\in\mathb{R}^{H\times W\times 3}, (1) I \ mathb{I}表示RGB图像,每个像素与3D坐标相关. HiSpatial使用MoGe风格的单体几何估计,其原始配体从单一图像中预测出一个亲缘-内变点图[3]. 计量尺度点图与目标基准特别相关,因为一些任务需要在物理单位中进行定量推理,而不仅仅是定性空间关系.

blocks.en: HiSpatial-3B is built on a PaliGemma2-3B visual-language backbone. PaliGemma 2 combines a SigLIP vision encoder with the Gemma 2 language model and is explicitly designed as a transfer-friendly VLM family [ 4 ] . HiSpatial adds 3D-aware processing so that visual representations can be conditioned on both appearance and geometry. A simplified representation of the learning objective is 𝐯 \displaystyle\mathbf{v} = E rgb ​ ( 𝐈 ) , \displaystyle=E_{\text{rgb}}(\mathbf{I}), (2) 𝐬 \displaystyle\mathbf{s} = E xyz ​ ( 𝐏 ) , \displaystyle=E_{\text{xyz}}(\mathbf{P}), (3) 𝐡 \displaystyle\mathbf{h} = F ⁡ ( 𝐯 , 𝐬 , 𝐪 ) , \displaystyle=F(\mathbf{v},\mathbf{s},\mathbf{q}), (4) ℒ SFT \displaystyle\mathcal{L}_{\text{SFT}} = − ∑ t log p θ ( y t ∣ y < t , 𝐡 ) , \displaystyle=-\sum_{t}\log p_{\theta}(y_{t}\mid y_{<t},\mathbf{h}), (5) where 𝐪 \mathbf{q} is a spatial question and y t y_{t} is the target answer token. This formulation is well matched to the project dataset, in which supervision is defined by physically meaningful geometric quantities and relations rather than by object semantics alone.

HiSpatial增加了3D-意识处理,以便视觉表现可以同时以外观和几何为条件. 简化表达学习目标为 v\displaystyle\mathbf{v} = E rgb (I),\displaystyle=E\text{rgb}}(\mathbf{I}), (2) s\displaystyle\mathbf{s} = E xyz (P),\displaysty=E\text{xyz{(\mathbf{P}), (3)h\displaystyle\mathbf{h}=F\\(v, s, q),\displaystyle=F(\mathbf{v},\mathbf{s},\mathbf{q}, (4) L SFT\displaystyle\ mathcal{L}_{\Q}_{\Text{SFT}}}= − t 日志 pθ (y t∣ y < t, h),\displaystyle=-\sum_{t}\log p_{\theta}(y_{t}\mid y_{<t},\mathbf{h}), (5) 其中 q\mathbf{q}是一个空间问题, y t_{t} 是目标答案符号 。 这种配方与项目数据集非常匹配,其中的监管是由物理上有意义的几何量和关系来定义的,而不是仅由对象语义来定义.

blocks.en: II-B Qwen3-VL: General Multimodal Reasoning with 3D Grounding
blocks.zh: II-B Quen3-VL: 通用多式理由加3D地面

blocks.en: Qwen3-VL follows a three-module multimodal architecture comprising a vision encoder, an MLP-based vision–language merger, and a Qwen3 language-model decoder [ 2 ] . Relative to earlier Qwen-VL generations, the model introduces interleaved MRoPE for improved spatial-temporal position modeling and DeepStack for injecting multi-level visual features into the language model. Its training recipe also explicitly includes spatial reasoning and 3D grounding data, making it a suitable general-purpose counterpart to the more geometry-specialized HiSpatial pipeline.
blocks.zh: Qune3-VL采用三种模块的多式联运结构,包括视觉编码器、基于MLP的视觉-语言合并和Qune3语言-模型解码器[2]。 与早期的Quen-VL代相比,该模型引入了间叶MROPE,用于改进时空位置模型和DeepStack,用于向语言模型中注入多层次视觉特征. 其培训配方还明确包括空间推理和立体定位数据,使其成为比较几何化的专门空间管道的合适通用对应物.

blocks.en: For adaptation in this project, Qwen3-VL is treated as a general multimodal foundation model and fine-tuned with a QLoRA-style recipe. QLoRA keeps the pretrained base model in low precision while optimizing low-rank adapters [ 5 ] . For a frozen quantized weight matrix 𝐖 ^ 0 \widehat{\mathbf{W}}_{0} , the adapted transformation is 𝐲 = ( 𝐖 ^ 0 + α ​ 𝐁𝐀 ) ​ 𝐱 , \mathbf{y}=\left(\widehat{\mathbf{W}}_{0}+\alpha\mathbf{B}\mathbf{A}\right)\mathbf{x}, (6) where 𝐀 \mathbf{A} and 𝐁 \mathbf{B} are low-rank trainable matrices. This substantially reduces memory use and makes 8B/32B adaptation feasible on limited GPU resources.
blocks.zh: 对于这个项目的适应,Qune3-VL作为一般的多式联运基础模型对待,并用QLORA式的配方进行微调. QLORA在优化低级适配器的同时,将预训基型保持低精度. blocks.en: The two branches provide complementary adaptation strategies. HiSpatial introduces explicit geometry at the input level, whereas Qwen3-VL relies primarily on learned visual-language representations and spatial priors. Evaluating both pipelines therefore helps separate limitations in geometric reconstruction from limitations introduced by domain adaptation, instruction formatting, or language-side reasoning.
blocks.zh: 这两个处提供互补的适应战略。 HiSpatial在输入层引入了显式几何,而Qune3-VL则主要依赖于学习到的视觉语言表现和空间前身. 因此,评估这两个管道有助于将几何重建方面的限制与域调整、指令格式化或语言侧推理带来的限制分开。

blocks.en: III Provided Dataset and Task Formulation
blocks.zh: 三. 提供的数据集和任务拟订

blocks.en: III-A Dataset Organization
blocks.zh: 三-A 数据集组织

blocks.en: The provided dataset was collected and refined in several batches. The implemented pipeline supports raw and styled RGB images, colored bounding-box overlays, instance masks, camera-pose metadata, per-scene annotations, and JSONL-formatted VQA supervision. For the building-centric scenes, CAD/GLB-derived 3D assets are also available and can be incorporated in future geometry-aware extensions.
blocks.zh: 已分几批收集和改进了所提供的数据集。 已执行的管道支持原始和样式的RGB图像,彩色的边框覆盖,实例口罩,相机拥有元数据,每个场景的说明,以及JSONL格式化的VQA监督. 对于以建筑为中心的场景,CAD/GLB衍生的3D资产也可用,并且可以纳入未来的几何感知扩展.

blocks.en: Evaluation is task-aware. Counting questions use direct comparison, metric questions such as height and distance use numerical parsing with a relative-tolerance criterion, and open-form relational answers are normalized and evaluated semantically. This design makes the evaluator robust to surface-form variation while preserving stricter treatment of quantitative outputs.

blocks.en: IV Engineering Pipeline
blocks.zh: 四. 工程管道

blocks.en: IV-A End-to-End System Overview
blocks.zh: 四. A. 终到终系统概览

blocks.en: Figure 3 summarizes the completed workflow. A shared data layer first prepares model-independent VQA records and validates image–annotation alignment. The HiSpatial branch then augments each image with a dense 3D point map and serializes the result for full-model supervised fine-tuning, whereas the Qwen3-VL branch converts the same task supervision into multimodal conversational instructions for QLoRA adaptation. Both branches converge on a common checkpointed inference and automated evaluation stage.
blocks.zh: 图3概述了已完成的工作流程。 共享数据层首先编写模型独立的VQA记录,并验证图像–注释对齐. HiSpatial分支然后用密集的3D点映射来增强每个图像,并将结果序列化为全模有监督的微调,而Qune3-VL分支则将相同的任务监督转换成QLORA的多模式对话指令. 这两个处都集中在一个共同的检查结论和自动评价阶段。

blocks.en: Fig. 3: Implemented fine-tuning and evaluation pipeline. The two model-specific branches share the same task supervision and evaluation interface but differ in geometric preprocessing and adaptation strategy.
blocks.zh: 图3:实施微调和评估程序。 两个模型专用分支共享相同的任务监督和评价接口,但在几何预处理和适应策略上有所不同.

blocks.en: IV-B HiSpatial Data Preparation
blocks.zh: IV-B 空间数据编制

blocks.en: The HiSpatial training stack requires synchronized RGB inputs, spatial tensors, and VQA metadata. The implemented preprocessing stage performs four main operations: 1. load the target scene image and its aligned VQA records; 2. run MoGe on the image to produce a dense XYZ tensor; 3. serialize the image, geometry tensor, and conversation/answer metadata into WebDataset-style samples; 4. mix target-domain samples with general visual instruction data before fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: HiSpatial训练堆需要同步的RGB输入,空间亮度,和VQA元数据. 已执行的预处理阶段主要执行四项业务: 1. 加载目标场景图像及其对齐的VQA记录; 2. 运行 MoGe在图像上生成一个稠密的XYZ 亮度;3. 将图像,几何亮度,和对话/答题元数据序列化为WebDataset风格的样本;4. 在微调前将目标域样本与一般视觉指令数据混合.

blocks.en: load the target scene image and its aligned VQA records;
blocks.zh: 装入目标场景图像及其对齐的VQA记录;

blocks.en: run MoGe on the image to produce a dense XYZ tensor;
blocks.zh: 运行 图像上的 MoGe 生成密集的 XYZ 亮度;

blocks.en: serialize the image, geometry tensor, and conversation/answer metadata into WebDataset-style samples;
blocks.zh: 将图像、几何计数器和对话/回答元数据序列化为WebDataset式样本;

blocks.en: mix target-domain samples with general visual instruction data before fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 在微调前将目标域样本与一般视觉指示数据混合.

blocks.en: In the first successful adaptation setting, target-domain building data were mixed with LLaVA-NeXT-style general VQA samples at approximately a 1:1 ratio. Prior work on broad visual instruction tuning highlights the value of diverse supervision for preserving general multimodal behavior [ 6 ] . This consideration is also supported by our experiments: highly concentrated spatial supervision can teach the target answer format effectively while simultaneously narrowing the response distribution of a general VLM.
blocks.zh: 在第一个成功的适应设定中,目标域建筑数据与LLaVA-NEXT型通用VQA样本混合,比例约为1:1. 以往关于广义视觉指导的调整工作突出了多种监督对维护一般多式联运行为的价值[6]。 我们的实验也支持这一考虑:高度集中的空间监督可以有效地教授目标答案格式,同时缩小一般VLM的响应分布.

blocks.en: The prepared HiSpatial samples contain three synchronized components: 𝒟 HiSpatial = { ( 𝐈 i , 𝐏 i , 𝐜 i ) } i = 1 N , \mathcal{D}_{\text{HiSpatial}}=\{(\mathbf{I}_{i},\mathbf{P}_{i},\mathbf{c}_{i})\}_{i=1}^{N}, (7) where 𝐏 i \mathbf{P}_{i} is the precomputed point map and 𝐜 i \mathbf{c}_{i} is the VQA conversation. Precomputing and serializing the point maps decouples geometry estimation from model optimization, reduces repeated preprocessing cost, and improves experiment reproducibility.
blocks.zh: 制成的Hispatial样本包含三个同步组件: D Hispatial = {(Ii,Pi,ci)}i = 1 N,\mathcal{ D}_{\text{ Hisspatial }}=\{ (\mathbf{I}_{i},\mathbf{P}_{i},\mathb{c}_{i} \}_{i=1}^{N}, (7) 其中Pi \ mathbf{P}_{i}为预计算点地图,ci \ mathbf{c}_{i}为VQA对话. 将点图从模型优化中分解几何估计值进行预计算和序列化,降低重复预处理成本,提高实验可复制性.

blocks.en: IV-C HiSpatial Fine-Tuning and Checkpoint Evaluation
blocks.zh: IV-C 空间精细和检查站评价

blocks.en: Training and inference are maintained in separate environments to reduce dependency conflicts. Fine-tuning starts from the released HiSpatial-3B checkpoint rather than from random initialization. The initial validated configuration used a per-device batch size of 4, an effective total batch size of 32, 1,200 optimization steps, and checkpointing every 400 steps. Subsequent runs extended the training horizon and adjusted the data mixture while preserving the same end-to-end pipeline.
blocks.zh: 培训和推断在不同的环境中进行,以减少依赖性冲突。 精细调整从释放的HISPATIAL-3B检查站开始,而不是从随机初始化开始. 初步审定的配置采用每装置批量大小4个,有效批量总大小32个,1200个优化步骤,每400步检查一次. 随后运行扩展了训练视野,并调整了数据混合物,同时保留了相同的端对端管道.

blocks.en: Training can be launched through the project-level wrapper: ⬇ # HiSpatial training environment conda activate hispatial - train # Example launch bash scripts / run_train . sh configs / train_finetune_lhzzzzzy . json
blocks.zh: 培训可通过项目一级的包装器进行: # 空间训练环境 conda 激活他的空间 - 列车# 例发射击掌脚本 / run_train. sh configs / train_finetune_lhzzzzy.json

blocks.en: Checkpoint evaluation is fully automated. Each selected checkpoint is loaded, evaluated over a JSONL test split, and exported to a standardized prediction file that is then consumed by the task-aware evaluator. The same interface also supports later styled-image variants and colored bounding-box prompts, allowing new visual-input formats to be tested without changing the evaluation protocol.
blocks.zh: 检查站评价完全自动化。 每个选定的检查站都装上炸药,通过JSONL测试分解进行评估,然后输出到标准化的预测文件,然后由任务感应评价员消耗。 同一界面还支持后来的样式图像变体和彩色的边框提示,允许在不改变评价协议的情况下测试新的视觉输入格式.

blocks.en: IV-D Qwen3-VL Instruction Construction and QLoRA
blocks.zh: IV-D Quen3-VL 指令建筑和QLORA

blocks.en: For Qwen3-VL, the same VQA supervision is transformed into the multimodal conversational format expected by the fine-tuning framework. A representative training record is ⬇ { " image ": [".../ sample_000101 / rgb_mask_id_overlay . png "], " conversations ": [ {" from ": " human ", " value ": " How many buildings are ...?\ n < image >"}, {" from ": " gpt ", " value ": " There are ... buildings ."} ] }

The first experiment used 1,000 scenes, with 900 assigned to training and 100 to testing. Because each scene contributes 12 question types, this split yields approximately 10,800 training QA instances and 1,200 test instances.
blocks.zh: 第一次实验使用了1000场场景,900场分配用于训练,100场用于测试. 由于每个场景都提供了12个问题类型,因此这种分割产生大约10 800个培训质量保证实例和1 200个测试实例。

blocks.en: The implemented Qwen adaptation uses 4-bit quantization with low-rank adapters to reduce memory consumption. In the lightweight recipe, the vision encoder remains frozen while LoRA parameters are optimized in language-side transformer projections; the multimodal connector can also be enabled depending on the configuration. This design makes 8B- and 32B-scale specialization feasible without maintaining gradients for the full pretrained parameter set.
blocks.zh: 已执行的Quen改编使用4位配低档适配器的量化,以减少内存消耗. 在轻量级配方中,视觉编码器仍然冻结,而LORA参数则在语言侧变压器预测中得到优化;多式联运连接器也可以根据配置情况启用. 这种设计使得8B-和32B-尺度的专业化是可行的,而无需保持全预训参数集的梯度.

blocks.en: IV-E Unified Inference and Evaluation
blocks.zh: IV-E 统一推论和评价

blocks.en: A common inference interface maps each sample identifier to its image, executes the selected model/checkpoint, and writes one normalized JSON object per prediction. The downstream evaluator then applies task-specific scoring: direct matching for counting, numerical parsing with relative tolerance for metric estimation, and semantic normalization for open-form spatial answers.
blocks.zh: 常见的推论接口将每个样本标识符映射到其图像,执行选定的模型/检查点,并写出每个预测的JSON正常对象. 下游评价员然后应用特定任务的评分:直接匹配计数,用相对的容积来解析计量估计,以及开放形式的空间答案的语义正常化.

blocks.en: A unified multi-model runner additionally allows HiSpatial, Qwen3-VL, LLaVA-3D, and SpatialRGPT to consume the same JSONL benchmark. This abstraction removes model-specific evaluation scripts from the comparison loop and makes checkpoint/model comparisons substantially more reproducible.
blocks.zh: 统一的多型跑车额外允许Hispatial,Qune3-VL,LLaVA-3D,和SpaceRGPT消耗相同的JSONL基准. 这种抽象从比较循环中删除了针对模型的评价脚本,使检查点/模型的比较大大地更加可复制.

blocks.en: V Experimental Results and Engineering Findings
blocks.zh: 五. 实验结果和工程结果

blocks.en: V-A HiSpatial Reproduction Sanity Check
blocks.zh: V-A 空间生殖卫生检查

blocks.en: Before target-domain adaptation, the reproduced HiSpatial training and inference stack was validated on standard spatial benchmarks. Despite using substantially less compute than the original training setup, the reproduced pipeline achieved 94.17% on CV-Bench-3D, 94.77% on CV-Bench Relation, 73.90% on EmbSpatial, and 78.05% on RoboSpatial in the project records. These measurements are used as an implementation sanity check rather than as a claim of full reproduction of the original training regime.
blocks.zh: 在目标域改造之前,复制的HiSpatial培训和推论堆栈在标准空间基准上得到了验证. 尽管使用的计算比最初的训练设置少得多,但复制的管道在CV-Bench-3D上达到了94.17%,在CV-Bench关系上达到了94.77%,在EmbSpatial上达到了73.90%,在项目记录上达到了78.05%的RoboSpatial. 这些衡量标准被用作执行理智的检查,而不是要求完全复制原始培训制度。

blocks.en: V-B Target-Domain HiSpatial Adaptation
blocks.zh: V-B 目标领域空间适应

blocks.en: The clearest quantitative outcome of the completed engineering work is the successful target-domain adaptation of HiSpatial. As shown in Table II , overall accuracy on the original building-centric benchmark rises from 1.73% before adaptation to 64.69% after 1,200 steps, 73.90% after 2,400 steps, and 79.89% after 3,600 steps.
blocks.zh: 完成的工程工程最明显的量化成果是Hispatial成功的目标域改造. 如表二所示,以建筑为中心的原始基准的总体准确性从适应前的1.73%上升到1 200步后的64.69%、2 400步后的73.90%和3 600步后的79.89%。

blocks.en: TABLE II: Recorded HiSpatial accuracy on the original target dataset during fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 表格 二:微调时在原目标数据集上录制的hiSpatial精度.

blocks.en: The improvement is not confined to the original target split. On a separately collected styled dataset, accuracy increases from 14.9% for the released model to 49.2%, 52.8%, and 55.1% for the 1,200-, 2,400-, and 3,600-step checkpoints, respectively. The consistent gain on this separate split provides evidence that the pipeline is learning transferable task structure rather than merely memorizing the original scenes.
blocks.zh: 改进不仅限于最初的目标分割。 在单独收集的分类数据集中,发布模式的准确度分别从14.9%提高到49.2%、52.8%和55.1%,分别为1 200个、2 400个和3 600个步检点。 这种分开的一贯收益提供了证据,证明管道正在学习可转移的任务结构,而不是仅仅记忆原始场景。

blocks.en: A later data-mixture experiment further showed that answer-format composition materially affects adaptation. Naively combining free-form and multiple-choice supervision caused a pronounced drop on the original free-form task, whereas an 8:2 mixture recovered strong performance. This result indicates that output-format distribution should be treated as an explicit component of the training domain rather than as an incidental formatting choice.
blocks.zh: 后来的一项数据混合实验进一步表明,答案格式的构成对适应产生了实质性影响。 自然结合自由式和多选择监督导致原自由式任务明显下降,而8:2的混合物恢复了强性能. 这一结果表明,产出格式的分发应作为培训领域的一个明确组成部分,而不是作为附带的格式选择。

blocks.en: V-C Qwen3-VL Fine-Tuning with Mixed-Domain Supervision
blocks.zh: V-C Qwen3-VL 数据 与混合领域监督的罚款

blocks.en: The Qwen3-VL adaptation pipeline was implemented for both the 8B and 32B variants using memory-efficient QLoRA. Following the data-mixture strategy adopted for HiSpatial, the target-domain spatial instruction data were combined with general multimodal instruction samples during fine-tuning. This mixed-domain formulation was designed to adapt the models to the target spatial tasks while retaining the broader visual-language capabilities of the pretrained models.
blocks.zh: Qwen3-VL的适应管道在8B和32B两个变体中都采用了内存高效的QLORA. 按照为Hispatial采用的数据混合战略,在微调时将目标域空间指示数据与一般多式联运指示样本结合。 这种混合域配方的设计是为了使模型适应目标空间任务,同时保留预训模型更广泛的视觉语言能力.

blocks.en: The resulting checkpoints show clear improvements over the corresponding pretrained baselines. As summarized in Table III , Qwen3-VL-8B improves from 20.74% before fine-tuning to 45.27% after mixed-domain adaptation, while Qwen3-VL-32B improves from 30.79% to 47.60%. These results demonstrate that the implemented QLoRA pipeline can successfully specialize both model scales to the target spatial benchmark when the target supervision is balanced with more general multimodal instruction data.
blocks.zh: 由此设立的检查站表明,与经过事先培训的相应基线相比,情况明显改善。 如表三所示,Qune3-VL-8B的调整率从微调前的20.74%提高到混合领域调整后的45.27%,而Qune3-VL-32B的调整率则从30.79%提高到47.60%。 这些结果表明,在目标监督与更一般的多式联运指令数据相平衡时,已实施的QLORA管道能够成功地将两个模型都专门用于目标空间基准。

blocks.en: TABLE III: Qwen3-VL accuracy before and after mixed-domain QLoRA fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 表三:混合域QLORA微调前后的Wen3-VL精度.

blocks.en: The improvement is consistent with the behavior observed in the HiSpatial experiments: concentrated target-domain supervision alone is not necessarily the most effective adaptation strategy for a general-purpose multimodal model, whereas mixed-domain training provides a better balance between task specialization and capability retention. In the present implementation, the same general strategy is therefore used for both model families, although the optimization mechanisms differ: HiSpatial is adapted with its RGB+3D training pipeline, while Qwen3-VL is optimized through low-rank adapters on top of the quantized pretrained model.
blocks.zh: 这种改进与Hispatial实验中观察到的行为是一致的:集中目标领域监督不一定是通用多式联运模式最有效的适应战略,而混合领域培训则在任务专业化与能力保留之间提供了更好的平衡。 因此,在目前的实施中,对两个示范家庭采用了同样的一般战略,尽管优化机制各不相同: HiSpatial以其RGB+3D训练管道进行改造,而Qwen3-VL则通过低档适配器在已分解的预训型号上进行优化.

blocks.en: The successful Qwen3-VL experiments also complete the second model branch of the engineering pipeline. The implementation covers instruction conversion, mixed-domain dataset construction, QLoRA optimization, checkpoint serialization and reloading, standardized batch inference, and automated evaluation for both 8B- and 32B-scale models.
blocks.zh: 成功的Quen3-VL实验也完成了工程管道的第二模型分支. 实施范围包括指令转换,混合域数据集构建,QLORA优化,检查站序列化和重装,标准化批量推论,以及8B级和32B级模型的自动化评价.

blocks.zh: 目前的执行情况

blocks.en: Table IV summarizes the completed components.
blocks.zh: 表四汇总了已完成的组成部分。

blocks.en: VI Reproducibility and Software Organization
blocks.zh: 六. 可复制性和软件组织

blocks.en: The software stack separates data conversion, training, inference, and evaluation environments in order to minimize dependency conflicts across model families. The principal environments are hispatial , hispatial-train , and qwen3vl , with additional environments reserved for spatial-VLM baselines.
blocks.zh: 软件堆栈将数据转换,培训,推论,评价环境分开,以尽量减少模型家族之间的依赖冲突. 主要环境有:肝脏、肝脏列车和qwen3vl,另外还保留了空间-VLM基线环境。

blocks.en: Each experiment is designed to be recoverable from four artifacts: (1) the dataset JSONL, (2) the corresponding image root, (3) the model checkpoint and configuration, and (4) the exported evaluation results. A minimal HiSpatial evaluation run therefore has the form ⬇ conda activate hispatial - train python tools / run_hispatial_checkpoint_jsonl . py \ -- dataset < test . jsonl > \ -- image - root < image_dir > \ -- checkpoint < checkpoint . ckpt > \ -- output < predictions . jsonl > conda activate hispatial python tools / eval_data4_color_preds . py \ -- input < predictions_aug . jsonl > \ -- output < evaluation . json >
blocks.zh: 每个实验的设计都从四个文物中可回收:(1)数据集JSONL,(2)对应的图像根,(3)模型检查点和配置,(4)输出的评价结果. 因此,一个最小的HiSpatial评价运行有 QQ conda 激活他的patial - 火车python工具 / run_hispatial_checkpoint_jsonl. py\ - 数据集 < 测试.jsonl >\ - 图像 - root < 图像_ dir >\ -- 检查站 < 检查站. ckpt > \ -- 输出 < 预测. jsonl >  conda 激活他的python 工具 / eval_data4_color_preds. py\ -- 输入 < 预测_aug. jsonl > \ -- 输出 < 评估. json >

blocks.en: The same convention is used for Qwen3-VL: each checkpoint is passed through the standardized runner and produces predictions in the same JSONL schema. Consequently, downstream model comparison does not require evaluator-specific changes. The use of a shared data interface and evaluation protocol also makes it possible to compare different adaptation strategies without modifying the benchmark implementation.
blocks.zh: Qwen3-VL也采用同样的惯例:每个检查站通过标准化的跑道,并在相同的JSONL schema中产生预测. 因此,下游模式的比较并不需要针对评估者的改动。 使用共享数据接口和评价协议也可以比较不同的适应战略,而不修改基准执行情况。

blocks.en: VII Discussion and Next Steps
blocks.zh: 七. 讨论和下一步

blocks.en: The experiments lead to three main observations. First, the HiSpatial pipeline performs strongly on the target spatial benchmark, benefiting from explicit RGB+point-map inputs for metric reasoning. Second, mixed-domain training is effective for both model families. Under this strategy, Qwen3-VL-8B improves from 20.74% to 45.27%, while Qwen3-VL-32B improves from 30.79% to 47.60%. Third, HiSpatial and Qwen3-VL provide complementary adaptation strategies: the former relies on explicit 3D geometry, whereas the latter achieves substantial gains through parameter-efficient multimodal instruction tuning.
blocks.zh: 实验导致三个主要观测结果. 首先,HiSpatial管道在目标空间基准方面表现强劲,受益于明确的RGB+点图用于衡量推理。 第二,混合领域培训对两个模范家庭都是有效的。 在这一战略下,Qune3-VL-8B从20.74%提高到45.27%,而Qune3-VL-32B则从30.79%提高到47.60%。 第三,Hispatial和Qwen3-VL提供了互补的适应战略:前者依靠明确的3D几何,而后者通过参数效率高的多式联运指令调制而取得巨大收益。

blocks.en: Future work will focus on target/general data-mixture ratios, task-wise evaluation, input-format ablations, and comparisons between monocular point maps and geometry derived directly from the available 3D assets or camera metadata.
blocks.zh: 今后的工作将侧重于目标/一般数据混合比率、任务评价、输入格式拼图以及直接从现有立体资产或相机元数据中得出的单位点地图和几何的比较。

blocks.en: VIII Conclusion
blocks.zh: 八 结论

blocks.en: This work establishes two end-to-end adaptation pipelines for a custom 3D-aware spatial benchmark. The HiSpatial pipeline improves overall accuracy from 1.73% to 79.89% and raises performance on a separately collected styled split from 14.9% to 55.1%. The Qwen3-VL pipeline is implemented for both 8B and 32B models using mixed-domain QLoRA, improving accuracy from 20.74% to 45.27% and from 30.79% to 47.60%, respectively.
blocks.zh: 这项工作为定制的3D-意识空间基准确定了两个端到端的适应管道. HiSpatial管道的总体精度从1.73%提高到79.89%,并将单独收集的分型的性能从14.9%提高到55.1%。 8B型和32B型采用混合领域QLORA, Quen3-VL输油管的精度分别从20.74%提高到45.27%和30.79%提高到47.60%。

blocks.en: Overall, the project provides a reproducible engineering foundation for further study of metric 3D reasoning, spatial grounding, multimodal data mixing, and geometry-aware model adaptation.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,该项目为进一步研究公尺立体推理、空间地面、多式联运数据混合和几何意识模型的适应性提供了可复制的工程基础。
